zh.lead: 今天最大的产品消息：OpenAI 推出 ChatGPT Wallet，在 dots 上开始代理支付；codex 稳定版同日连发 0.168.0 与 0.169.0；CursorBench 新上榜 Gemini 4 Hydrogen Extra High，进入官方得分第 6。

important.title: 重要消息
items: OpenAI 于 11/13 发布 ChatGPT Wallet：与 Amex、Mastercard、Visa 合作的代理支付。用户添加一次卡片，每次核对商品、总额与所用卡并用生物识别批准；网络侧下发支付 token，不把真实卡号交给商家或智能体。今日起在 dots 向美国 ChatGPT Pro（18 岁以上、符合条件的美国发卡）滚动上线，并发布商家 playbook。
codex 稳定版在昨日早报之后连发 0.168.0（约北京时间 11/13 11:54）与 0.169.0（约 16:37）。0.168 加入模型提供方选择、可选侧边对话、录音附件与 GIF 生成；0.169 让可选终端工作区支持多个侧边对话标签、可搜索历史任务，并增加折叠回合细节、终端内配置自定义提供方，以及可选的 Cloud 连接。实验线最新为 0.171.0-alpha.4。
CursorBench 4.0 新上榜 Gemini 4 Hydrogen Extra High：57.8% / $5.86，进入官方得分第 6，与 Opus 5.5 Max 同分；Sonnet 5.5 Max（55.5%）跌出官方前 10。GitHub Copilot 亦于 11/13 宣布 Hydrogen 对 Pro 到 Enterprise 等计划全面可用，按提供方定价计量。

sections.title: ChatGPT Wallet 怎么付
sections.body: 每次下单都要本人批准并留下记录。批准后由支付网络提供一次性 token，真实卡号不共享；现有奖励与符合条件的争议保护仍适用。官方还提到，后续或可按额度、品类或时段预先授权。商家需避免误拦智能体，并与风控、支付服务商一起减少误拒。目前仅限美国 Pro 的早期阶段。

sections.title: Google：钱包接入、气象数据与积分
sections.body: Gemini 应用新增 Google Wallet 连接（美国用户），官方称只能读账户，不能划转或投资。DeepMind 同日开源 WeatherNext 3 背后的 PARDIG（全球降水，约每 15 分钟，并提供 1999–2026 历史档案）与 SatWeave（五颗地球同步卫星拼成的云与风暴图，约每 60 分钟），数据在 Cloud Storage 和 Earth Engine。Google AI Pro / Ultra 用户也可在 AI Studio 内领取开发者云积分。

sections.body: DeepSeek Harness 新实验版 dsh-v0.2.2-rc.3，可导入 DeepSeek 历史会话并修复 Windows 更新问题。Hermes 稳定版仍为 v0.23.1，11/13 仅有 canary。OpenClaw 无新标签；Cursor changelog 自 11/6 无新条目。Grok Bot 官方 changelog Latest 仍为 11/11 的 v1.0.1，但 Homebrew cask 已报 1.0.3，高于 changelog，故不以「近几日无新版本」表述。

en.lead: Biggest product news today: OpenAI launched ChatGPT Wallet, starting agentic payments in dots; Codex shipped two stable releases, 0.168.0 and 0.169.0, on the same day; and CursorBench added Gemini 4 Hydrogen Extra High, which enters the official scoreboard at #6.

important.title: Headlines
items: On Nov 13 OpenAI introduced ChatGPT Wallet, an agentic payments product built with American Express, Mastercard, and Visa. Users add a card once, then review the items, total, and selected card and approve each purchase with a check such as Face ID or a fingerprint; the network issues a payment token, so the real card number is not shared with the business or the agent. It starts rolling out today in dots for ChatGPT Pro subscribers in the US (18+, eligible US-issued cards), alongside a Commerce Partner Playbook for businesses.

After yesterday’s brief, Codex published two stables: rust-v0.168.0 (2026-11-13T03:54:29Z, about 11:54 Asia/Shanghai) and rust-v0.169.0 (2026-11-13T08:37:05Z, about 16:37). 0.168 adds model-provider selection, an optional side conversation (features.tui_workspace), attaching recordings, and GIF generation. 0.169 lets the opt-in terminal workspace hold multiple side-chat tabs, search older tasks by name or directory, collapse turn details, configure custom providers in the terminal, and optionally talk to Cloud. The experimental line is now at 0.171.0-alpha.4.

CursorBench 4.0 adds Gemini 4 Hydrogen Extra High at 57.8% / $5.86, entering the official scoreboard at #6, tied with Opus 5.5 Max; Sonnet 5.5 Max (55.5%) drops out of the official top 10. GitHub Copilot also announced Hydrogen as generally available on Nov 13 for plans from Pro through Enterprise, billed at provider list pricing, with a gradual rollout.

sections.title: How ChatGPT Wallet pays
sections.body: Users add a card once and personally approve every order, leaving a record of authorization. After approval, the payment network supplies a one-time payment token (a stand-in for the card number, security code, and expiration date); the real card number is not shared with the business or the agent, and existing rewards and eligible dispute protections still apply. OpenAI also says that, later, users should be able to pre-approve purchases within limits, categories, or time windows so the agent can buy on its own inside those bounds. Businesses need to avoid CDN or firewall rules that block agents (the post mentions Web Bot Auth) and work with risk and payment providers to cut false declines. This is an early phase limited to US Pro users.

sections.title: Google: Wallet, weather data, and credits
sections.body: Personal Intelligence in the Gemini app now includes Google Wallet: US users can connect it so replies can draw on their spending habits. Officially, Gemini can only read the accounts; it cannot move, manage, or invest money. The same day, Google DeepMind released two foundational datasets behind WeatherNext 3: PARDIG, an AI precipitation dataset (officially about every 15 minutes, with precipitation-detection skill up more than 30%, plus a 1999–2026 historical archive), and SatWeave, a mosaic of five geostationary satellites into a global view of clouds and storms (updated about every 60 minutes). The data is on Google Cloud Storage, and PARDIG’s historical catalogs are also on Earth Engine. Separately, Google AI Pro and Ultra subscribers can claim Google Developer Program Cloud credits inside AI Studio and start calling the Gemini API there.

sections.title: Product notes
sections.body: DeepSeek Harness has a new experimental tag, dsh-v0.2.2-rc.3 (2026-11-13T07:56:55Z, about 15:57 Asia/Shanghai): an experimental plugin to import past DeepSeek App or web chats into a workspace and keep talking, plus a fix for Windows desktop in-app updates that could fail and not reopen automatically. Hermes Agent’s latest stable is still v0.23.1 (Nov 10); a canary, v0.23.1+canary.20261113T064447Z, also shipped on Nov 13 and is not a new stable. OpenClaw’s latest prerelease is still v2026.11.5-beta.2, and stable remains v2026.11.3. Cursor’s changelog still has no new entry since Voice Chat with Agents on Nov 6. Grok Bot’s official changelog Latest is still v1.0.1 from Nov 11 (meetings and shared connectors); the Homebrew cask grok-bot now reports 1.0.3, ahead of the changelog, so this is not written as “no recent new version.” The official page does not yet list what 1.0.3 changes.

sections.title: Gaps
sections.body: @karpathy, @AndrewYNg, @OpenAI, @claudeai, and @Meta had no high-signal original posts in the last 24–48 hours. The ChatGPT Wallet official post could be extracted, but a page screenshot did not come through, so that item has no image. The follow list still has no first-party DeepSeek account on X. Anthropic’s newsroom had no new product post today; @AnthropicAI also previewed a fireside chat with JPMorgan CEO Jamie Dimon (more company / IPO roadshow than a tech item, so it is not expanded here).

title.zh: ChatGPT Wallet：给智能体一套可被批准的支付方式

summary.zh: 11/13 产品稿：与 Amex、Mastercard、Visa 合作，让智能体在用户批准后完成购买。用户添加一次卡片，每次核对商品、总额与所用卡并用生物识别批准；网络侧下发支付 token，不把真实卡号交给商家或智能体，现有奖励与符合条件的争议保护仍适用。今日起在 dots 向美国 ChatGPT Pro（18 岁以上、符合条件的美国发卡）滚动上线，并发布 Commerce Partner Playbook，帮助商家避免误拦智能体、减少风控误拒。
summary.en: Nov 13 product post: with Amex, Mastercard, and Visa, agents can complete purchases after the user approves. Users add a card once, review the items, total, and card, and approve with a biometric check; the network issues a payment token, so the real card number is not shared with the business or the agent, and existing rewards and eligible dispute protections still apply. It starts rolling out today in dots for ChatGPT Pro subscribers in the US (18+, eligible US-issued cards), with a Commerce Partner Playbook so businesses can avoid blocking agents and cutting down false declines.

summary.en: The WeatherNext team on Nov 13 released SatWeave (a mosaic of five geostationary satellites into a global view of clouds and storms, about every 60 minutes) and PARDIG (an AI global precipitation dataset, about every 15 minutes, with precipitation-detection skill officially up more than 30%, plus a 1999–2026 historical archive). Both were key to WeatherNext 3 and are now on Google Cloud Storage; PARDIG’s historical catalogs are also on Earth Engine.

alphaxivTop3.title: Unbundling Multimodal Vision Encoding
alphaxivTop3.authors: Ellis Brown, Chris Hoang, Shengyi Qian, Shang-Wen Li, Mike Lewis, Marjan Ghazvininejad, Luke Zettlemoyer, Lucas Beyer, Mengye Ren, Jakob Verbeek, Saining Xie, Hu Xu et al.

summary.zh: （热榜第 1，新上榜）把多模态模型里视觉编码器的三项设计拆开对照：上游预训练带来的视觉先验、专用视觉容量，以及融合前放置。在统一数据与算力下从头训练后发现：视觉先验并非必要，联合从头训练的编码器可与预训练编码器相当；真正关键的是专用视觉容量，无编码器方案即使把骨干做大仍落后，但这些容量不必放在融合之前。
summary.en: (New #1 on alphaXiv’s trending list.) A controlled study that unbundles three choices in multimodal vision encoding: the visual prior from upstream pretraining, dedicated vision capacity, and whether that capacity sits before fusion. Trained from scratch on common data at matched compute, a jointly trained encoder matches a pretrained one — the visual prior is not necessary. Dedicated vision capacity is what matters; encoder-free models still trail even with a larger backbone, but that capacity need not precede fusion.

alphaxivTop3.title: Ropedia Xperience 2: A Gold Standard for Scaling Physical AI Environments and Behaviors
alphaxivTop3.authors: Hao Li, Fangzhou Hong, Zhaoxi Chen, Hui En Pang, Kairui Hu, Mingze Sun, Runmao Yao, Xinhao Ji, Xiyuan Zheng, Xuanli Chen, Yalun Dai, Yap Kim Hui et al.

summary.zh: （热榜第 2，新上榜；具身/智能体相关）指出 GPT-6 Astra、Claude Fable 5.1 等基础模型已能从视觉直接控制机器人，但在长程、富接触的真实任务上仍脆。论文提出规模化的物理 AI 环境与行为「金标准」，强调需要可监督任务如何完成的人类行为示范，以及相应的环境资源。
summary.en: (New #2; embodiment / agent-relevant.) Foundation models such as GPT-6 Astra and Claude Fable 5.1 can already control robots from visual observations, but remain brittle on long-horizon, contact-rich real-world tasks. The paper proposes a gold-standard resource for scaling physical-AI environments and behaviors, arguing that progress needs demonstrations of how humans perform tasks plus the matching environments.

alphaxivTop3.title: Latent Feedback Is a Compute and Data Amplifier: Scaling Law for Latent Feedback Transformers on Repeated Data
alphaxivTop3.authors: Benhao Huang, Chaitanya Dwivedi, Xuezhe Ma, Alexander Moreno, Hector Liu

summary.zh: （热榜第 3，新上榜）高质量数据耗尽后，常见做法是多轮重复训练，但每一轮的收益递减。本文研究潜空间反馈（把当前 token 顶层状态送入下一 token 输入）作为一种把算力花在重复数据上的方式，并给出在重复数据上的缩放律，称其可放大算力与数据效率。
summary.en: (New #3.) When high-quality data runs out, a common practice is to train for several epochs, but each repeat is worth less than the last. The paper studies latent feedback — feeding each token’s top-layer state into the next token’s input — as another way to spend that compute on repeated data, and reports a scaling law in which latent feedback acts as a compute and data amplifier.

summary.en: Two stables landed after yesterday’s brief: rust-v0.168.0 / 0.168.0 (2026-11-13T03:54:29Z) and rust-v0.169.0 / 0.169.0 (2026-11-13T08:37:05Z). 0.168 lets you browse model providers under Sessions and set the default for new chats, opens an optional side conversation with features.tui_workspace, supports attaching recordings when using an audio-capable model, and adds optional GIF generation. 0.169 gives the opt-in terminal workspace multiple side-chat tabs (and can reopen saved local side chats after restart), search older tasks by name, prompt preview, or working directory, collapse completed turn details in the full-screen transcript, and add or edit custom model providers in the terminal; on macOS and Linux it can also optionally connect to Cloud. The experimental line is now rust-v0.171.0-alpha.4 (notes name the version only).

summary.en: The official changelog Latest is still v1.0.1 (2026-11-11, and the entry also includes 1.0.0): on Team, Enterprise, and Ultra plans, a Bot can join Google Meet, Zoom, or Microsoft Teams from a link, reply in meeting chat, and send a summary afterward, and it supports shared-login connectors. The Homebrew cask grok-bot now reports 1.0.3 (the download points at the darwin-arm64 1.0.3 package), ahead of changelog Latest. Under the client-vs-changelog rule, this is not written as “no recent new version.” The official changelog does not yet list what 1.0.3 changes, so those features are not invented here.

changeSummary.zh: CursorBench 4.0 新上榜 Gemini 4 Hydrogen Extra High：57.8% / $5.86（约 9.86 分/$），进入官方得分第 6，与 Opus 5.5 Max 同分。其后配置的官方名次整体下移一位，Sonnet 5.5 Max（55.5%）跌出官方前 10；官方第 9–10 现为同分的 Opus 5.5 Extra High 与 Opus 5.5 High（均为 56.0%）。其余已有配置的得分与成本较昨日不变；性价比前 10 的成员未变，仅官方名次随总榜插入下移。榜上配置由 90 增至 91。页面上部分 steps 以整数显示，与昨日小数不完全相同，不作分数变化解读。
changeSummary.en: CursorBench 4.0 adds Gemini 4 Hydrogen Extra High at 57.8% / $5.86 (about 9.86 pts/$), entering the official scoreboard at #6, tied with Opus 5.5 Max. Official ranks below that shift down by one, and Sonnet 5.5 Max (55.5%) drops out of the official top 10; official #9–10 are now the tied Opus 5.5 Extra High and Opus 5.5 High (both 56.0%). Scores and costs for the other existing configs are unchanged versus yesterday; the value top 10 is the same set of models, with official ranks only moving because of the new entry. The board grows from 90 to 91 configs. Some step counts now display as integers on the official page, unlike yesterday’s decimals, and are not treated as score changes.

summary.en: Ranked by score ÷ cost per task, the highest-value configs remain the cheapest ones: GPT-5.6 Luna Low (16.0% / $0.03, about 533 pts/$) and Haiku 5.5 Low (30.9% / $0.08). The official scoreboard is still led by Gemini 4 Carbon High (60.4% / $9.22) and Carbon Medium (60.1%), then Fable 5.2 Max (60.0%); Hydrogen Extra High joins Opus 5.5 Max in the official top 6.
